prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” attorney for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, how contested liability is, and what style of representation you want (settlement-focused vs. trial-ready). I can help you find a good match. First, here are practical criteria and steps to pick the best one for your claim:

What to look for
- Relevant experience: handled many car-accident cases (not just general PI), with experience similar to your facts (rear-end, T-bone, uninsured motorist, catastrophic injury, wrongful death).
- Trial experience and verdict record: settlements are common, but trial experience matters if the insurer refuses to pay.
- Resources: access to medical experts, accident reconstructionists, and investigators for serious claims.
- Track record of outcomes: past settlements/verdicts in comparable cases.
- Reputation and peer recognition: AV Preeminent (Martindale‑Hubbell), Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, or awards from trial lawyer associations.
- Communication and responsiveness: clear point of contact, timely updates.
- Fee structure: contingency fee (commonly ~33% pre‑trial; up to 40% if suit/filed or on appeal), who advances costs, and how liens are handled.
- Local courtroom knowledge: familiarity with Chicago and Cook County judges and defense/insurance counsel.
- Client reviews and disciplinary history: read reviews and check Illinois Attorney Registration & Disciplinary Commission.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? How many?
- What was a typical recovery in similar cases?
- Will you personally handle my case or pass it to an associate?
- What is your fee and what costs will I owe if we don’t recover?
- How do you handle medical liens and health insurance subrogation?
- Do you take cases to trial? Recent trial results?
- How often will you update me and who is my main contact?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific dollar amount.
- Refusal to put fee terms in writing.
- Poor communication during intake or avoiding direct answers about experience.

Do you want me to:
- Look up highly rated Chicago car-accident lawyers/firms and give a short vetted list?
- Or help you draft the specifics to bring to consultations (summary of injuries, bills, police report, insurance info)?

If you give a few details about your accident (date, injuries, whether fault’s contested, severity), I can pull a tailored short list of experienced Chicago attorneys and what to expect next.
